posts.title: Reverse-Engineering the Wetware: Spiking Networks, TD Errors, and the End of Matrix Math
posts.description: An engineer-friendly deep dive into how the human brain truly processes information, learns without backpropagation, and uses spiking neural networks, predictive coding, and dopamine-driven TD errors—challenging our notions of AI and matrix math.

posts.title: Real-Time AI Streaming in Production: What We Built at Helpmaton
posts.description: How we evolved our Lambda-based real-time AI streaming stack for SaaS: integrating streaming, credit management, and subscription-based throttling. Patterns, challenges, and lessons from Helpmaton’s production deployment.

posts.title: Subscription-Based API Throttling Without Client API Keys
posts.description: How to implement tiered API throttling in AWS API Gateway using subscriptions, without requiring clients to send or manage API keys. Learn how to map subscriptions to usage plans with a custom Lambda authorizer for seamless and secure rate limiting.
